heading: INT. COURTROOM, MARITIME LAW DIVISION - DAY

units.text: INT. COURTROOM, MARITIME LAW DIVISION - DAY
Dark oak.
Brass fittings.
A model of a container ship sits on the evidence table, its cranes frozen mid-lift.
Salt-water stains the carpet near the jury box, a leak the clerk has long stopped noticing.
JUDGE HORTENSE ABELARD-OKONKWO (60s, half-moon glasses, voice like creaking rope) presides.
At the plaintiff's table stands attorney PERCIVAL GRIMSDYKE (50s, pinstripe, cane) with a thick binder.
Across the aisle, defense counsel BEATRIX NAKAMURA-FLYNN (40s, severe bun, red pen) leans casually on her chair.
Mr. Grimsdyke, you may proceed with your closing.
units.name: JUDGE ABELARD-OKONKWO

units.text: Thank you, Your Honor.
units.name: GRIMSDYKE

units.text: He rises slowly, leaning on the cane.
He addresses the empty jury box as though it were full.
Ladies and gentlemen, this case is about a ship. It is also about a promise.
units.name: GRIMSDYKE

units.text: It's about a bill of lading.
units.name: NAKAMURA-FLYNN

units.text: The Meridian Star sailed from Rotterdam with four thousand containers. Four thousand promises. Not one was delivered intact.
units.name: GRIMSDYKE

units.text: Mr. Grimsdyke, I hope you're going somewhere with this.
units.name: JUDGE ABELARD-OKONKWO

units.text: Yes, Your Honor.
units.name: GRIMSDYKE

units.text: He lifts the model ship from the table and turns it in his hands.
My client alleges that Ms. Nakamura-Flynn's client knowingly loaded cargo in violation of Article Nine.
units.name: GRIMSDYKE

units.text: Objection. Speculation.
units.name: NAKAMURA-FLYNN

units.text: Sustained. Rephrase.
units.name: JUDGE ABELARD-OKONKWO

units.text: My client alleges that the knowledge was there.
units.name: GRIMSDYKE

units.text: Objection. Still speculation.
units.name: NAKAMURA-FLYNN

units.text: Overruled. I'm curious.
units.name: JUDGE ABELARD-OKONKWO

units.text: Nakamura-Flynn sits, tapping her pen.
Finally.
units.name: GRIMSDYKE

units.text: He sets the model down gently.
It tips on its stand, a crane snaps off, and the sound ricochets around the silent room.
Four thousand promises, ladies and gentlemen. And a clerk who never fixed the leak.
units.name: GRIMSDYKE

units.text: Mr. Grimsdyke.
units.name: JUDGE ABELARD-OKONKWO

units.text: Your Honor?
units.name: GRIMSDYKE

units.text: That's enough.
units.name: JUDGE ABELARD-OKONKWO

units.text: He bows, retrieves his cane, and sits.
Nakamura-Flynn rises, buttons her jacket, and walks calmly to the evidence table.
She picks up the broken crane and weighs it in her palm.
Your Honor, my learned friend has just proven my case.
units.name: NAKAMURA-FLYNN

units.text: Do enlighten us.
units.name: JUDGE ABELARD-OKONKWO

units.text: A crane cannot be loaded wrong. It can only be broken. And broken things get insured.
units.name: NAKAMURA-FLYNN

units.text: Grimsdyke closes his eyes.
The judge exhales through her nose, and removes her glasses.
We will recess for lunch.
units.name: JUDGE ABELARD-OKONKWO
